title: Cut/clipped focus ring on modal footer buttons
answers: Focus ring around modal buttons is cut off or clipped
Button outline gets truncated at the bottom of a modal
Why does the focus ring look chopped off in a confirm dialog?
Modal button focus indicator is not fully visible
body:
Symptom: the keyboard-focus outline/ring around buttons in a modal's action row appears visually cut off at the edge. Root cause: wrapping the button row in a plain `
` + `` with only top padding (`buttonsContainer` style in packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/ConfirmContent.tsx) left no room/overflow allowance around the buttons for the focus ring to render fully. Fix pattern: replace the ad-hoc `
...
` wrapper with the shared `Modal.ButtonRow` component (packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Modal/Modal.tsx) which handles spacing/padding correctly for focus rings. Constraints: applies to any modal footer/action-button row built from scratch; if a component already uses `Modal.ButtonRow` this issue does not apply.
applies: grafana-ui Modal and modal-content components with footer button rows
